label: A claimed amino-acid change is impossible below the code distance
statement_en: With the standard genetic code as a 64-codon table and minSubst a b the least number of positions in which a codon for a and a codon for b differ, no codon pair turns a into b in fewer than minSubst a b nucleotide substitutions. A claim of n substitutions with n < minSubst a b is therefore impossible. minSubst is computed over the table, so the kernel evaluates each instance: Phe to Leu takes 1, Trp to Stop 1, Met to Trp 2.

lean.source:
/-- **A missense claim with too few substitutions is impossible.** -/
theorem claimed_substitutions_rules_out {a b : AminoAcid} {n : ℕ} (h : n < minSubst a b) :
    ¬ ∃ c d : Codon, code c = a ∧ code d = b ∧ hamming c d ≤ n := by
  rintro ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hn⟩
  have := minSubst_le hc hd
  omega

constraint_details.relation: n ≥ minSubst(a, b), the least Hamming distance between a codon for a and a codon for b
constraint_details.canEliminate: a claim that one point mutation produced an amino-acid change the code needs two or three for (for example methionine to tryptophan)
